Removed once as 'omaa tutkimusta ja tulkintaa' (own research and interpretation), not put back. Mostly plausible additions without sources; no clear slant or dispute beyond that, so capped at reverted.

Added text says Finland is 'sisällissodan osapuoli' (a party to a civil war) in Afghanistan, later with a 'sodan kaltaisiin sotatoimiin' (war-like operations) claim cited to a 1995 document. Added by 3 distinct editors/ranges (two anonymous ranges and one named), put back 5 times between 2009-10-07 and 2009-10-29 (over 7 days). Meets the structural signals; a possible ordinary content dispute among several editors, so least certain.
